review_notes: Read the whole file and Mathlib's LinearMap/Polynomial.lean (polyCharpoly_eq_of_basis, polyCharpolyAux definitions). The strongest duplication is between the private lemmas polyCharpoly_reindex (176–206) and polyCharpoly_changeBasis (247–281): identical trivial-ring split, Finite/Fintype γ setup, rewriting by polyCharpoly_eq_of_basis, Polynomial.map_map, congr 1, ringHom_ext, and the C-case. Only the final generator-case identity differs. I did not compile the proposed helper; the exact elaboration of `c.end` instances and the coercion of the AlgHom to RingHom may need small adjustments. Secondary repetition (the `let _ := Module.Free.of_basis b; let _ := Module.Finite.of_basis b` preambles, and the identical endings of coordinateNormPolynomial_reindex/changeBasis) is mostly routine and not reported.

findings.problem: The two private lemmas repeat the same nontrivial proof skeleton: case split on subsingleton/nontrivial R, constructing Finite γ and Fintype γ from the basis c, rewriting both polyCharpoly terms with polyCharpoly_eq_of_basis, Polynomial.map_map, congr 1, ringHom_ext, discharging the constant case by simp, and reducing the variable case via bind₁_X_right. Only the last step (the identity relating toMvPolynomial for the two bases) differs. This ~25-line machinery is copy-pasted, so any change in the Mathlib API (e.g. polyCharpoly_eq_of_basis) must be fixed twice.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one private lemma, e.g.

private theorem polyCharpoly_map_of_toMvPolynomial {R M N α β γ} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Module.Free R N] [Module.Finite R N] (b : Basis α R M) (b' : Basis β R M) (c : Basis γ R N) (f : M →ₗ[R] Module.End R N) (φ : MvPolynomial α R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial β R) (h : ∀ i, φ (LinearMap.toMvPolynomial b c.end f i) = LinearMap.toMvPolynomial b' c.end f i) : LinearMap.polyCharpoly f b' = (LinearMap.polyCharpoly f b).map φ.toRingHom.

Proof: the existing body (subsingleton case via Subsingleton.elim; otherwise rewrite with polyCharpoly_eq_of_basis for b' and b, Polynomial.map_map, congr 1, ringHom_ext, C-case by simp, variable case by simp only [..., bind₁_X_right] then `exact (h i).symm`). Then polyCharpoly_reindex becomes `polyCharpoly_map_of_toMvPolynomial b (b.reindex e) c f (MvPolynomial.rename e) (fun i => (linearMap_toMvPolynomial_reindex b c.end e f i).symm)` (with the rename ring-hom/AlgHom coercion matched), and polyCharpoly_changeBasis becomes the same call with φ := MvPolynomial.bind₁ (LinearMap.id.toMvPolynomial b' b) and h i obtained from `LinearMap.toMvPolynomial_comp b' b c.end f LinearMap.id` (the existing `rw [← ...]; rfl` step). The public theorems coordinateNormPolynomial_reindex and _changeBasis are unchanged.
findings.benefit: Removes about 25 duplicated lines, isolates the single mathematical idea (a substitution of the matrix-entry polynomials induces the corresponding map on polyCharpoly) in one place, and makes each use reduce to the only genuinely different fact: how toMvPolynomial transforms under the basis change. Maintenance against upstream API changes is done once.
